trace.notes: Normalized ARGUMENTS as the single zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/5916726 with trailing identifier 5916726.

Local shard metadata identified zbMATH 5916726 as the DOI-linked work 'Some open problems in nonlinear extended thermodynamics and their possible solutions' with DOI 10.1007/s11587-010-0095-4. The Springer landing page confirmed the exact source title, authors M. C. Carrisi and S. Pennisi, Ricerche di Matematica 60, pages 45-56, and DOI.

Failure mode: metadata_only and paywalled_or_restricted, with network_or_dns_failure in the local CLI fetch path. Shell curl could not resolve zbmath.org, api.zbmath.org, api.crossref.org, api.openalex.org, or link.springer.com. The accessible Springer page exposed only the title, abstract, references, DOI metadata, and subscription or purchase controls, not a readable full-text article containing the technical problem statements.

trace.notes: No document map was created because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source was recovered. The workflow stopped before candidate extraction to avoid extracting open problems from resolver metadata, abstracts, citation pages, search snippets, or related papers.

No accepted questions were produced because the only visible same-work content was metadata and abstract text. Extracting or rewriting questions from the Springer abstract, zbMATH/Crossref/OpenAlex metadata, search snippets, references, or citing articles would violate the source adequacy, evidence coverage, and no-new-facts gates.
